TRIAD.Empty: Select a token to see its actions.
TRIAD.Use: Use — or drag onto a token to target and use (right-click: post to chat)

Strike.Attack: Strike with the next MAP — or drag onto a token (right-click: post weapon)

Spell.Cast: Cast — or drag onto a token to target and cast (right-click: post to chat)

Combat.ActionsHint: Click to mark actions spent. Refreshes at the start of your turn.

Utility.Elevation: Elevation in ft — type the value and press Enter

Warn.NoToken: This actor has no token on the scene.
Warn.NoSocketlib: Triad: socketlib is not active — players won't be able to end their turn or mark actions from the tray in this world.

trayWidth.Name: Tray width
trayWidth.Hint: Width of the tray panel in pixels.

pushInterface.Name: Push interface
pushInterface.Hint: Shift Foundry's left UI to the right while the tray is open instead of overlapping it.

useAssignedCharacter.Name: Fall back to my character on this map
useAssignedCharacter.Hint: When no token is selected, show your character that has a token on the current map (your assigned character first). Characters that aren't on this map are never shown.

showUnreadyStrikes.Name: Show unready strikes
showUnreadyStrikes.Hint: Also list strikes for weapons that are not currently held.

section.Hint: Show this section in the Actions tab.

basicActions.Name: Basic actions
basicActions.Hint: Comma-separated PF2e action slugs shown in the quick action grid (e.g. stride, seek, grapple, raise-a-shield).

trackActions.Name: Track three actions
trackActions.Hint: Show clickable action/reaction pips during combat, refreshed automatically at the start of each turn.

openOnCombat.Name: Open when combat starts
openOnCombat.Hint: The tray opens automatically when an encounter begins and when you select one of your tokens during combat. Out of combat it stays the way you left it.

autoSpendActions.Name: Spend actions automatically
autoSpendActions.Hint: Using a Strike, spell, action, reload or Sustain from the tray marks its action cost on the turn tracker (only during that creature's turn); reactions mark the reaction. Pips can still be clicked by hand.

movementCostsActions.Name: Movement spends actions
movementCostsActions.Hint: Players only: moving a token on its own turn costs one action per Stride (Fly, Swim, Climb, Burrow use their Speed; without a Swim/Climb Speed, the Athletics success distance). The action is spent as soon as the Speed is reached, or when another action is used (a shorter Stride still costs one); meanwhile its pip shows dashed. Undoing a move refunds it. Using Stride or Step from the tray pays the action up front.

Error.Title: Triad could not show this token
Error.Partial: Some parts could not be read
Error.Console: Details in the console (Cmd+Option+I), lines starting with "triad |".

Reload.Label: Reload
Reload.Hint: Reload (Interact). Picks the ammo automatically when there is only one kind.
Reload.NoAmmo: No compatible ammunition in the inventory.

Target.Hint: Target: click, then click a token — or drag onto a token. Shift: add/remove. Esc cancels.
Target.Missed: Release over a token on the map.

TRIAD.UseButton: Use — posts the card to chat (area, saves and damage clickable for everyone)

RecallKnowledge.None: No skill can be used for this.

Move.Hint: Movement for this action. The action is spent when you reach your Speed, or when you use another action. Moving past it starts a new one.

Bomb.Hint: Load a lesser alchemical bomb into the bracket (Interact). The next three attacks deal +1d6 of the bomb's damage type.
Bomb.UnloadHint: Take the bomb out and put it back in the inventory.
Bomb.UnloadFired: Remove the bomb. It has been fired, so what is left is wasted.
Bomb.NoBombs: No lesser alchemical bomb that deals energy damage (acid, cold, electricity, fire, sonic…) in the inventory.
Bomb.AlreadyLoaded: A bomb is already loaded in this crossbow.
Bomb.EffectDescription: The next three attacks with {weapon} deal an extra 1d6 {damage} damage. The second and third attacks must come within 1 minute of the first, or the rest of the bomb is wasted. No splash or other bomb effects.
